citations.title: Schedule of Social Security Benefit Payments — Publication 05-10031

programs.name: SSI (Supplemental Security Income)
programs.summary: Usually paid on the 1st of the month. If the 1st is a weekend or federal holiday, payment is issued on the preceding business day.

rule.notes: January 2026 SSI for that month was issued Dec 31, 2025 because Jan 1 is a holiday — the engine applies the same preceding-business-day rule.

programs.name: Social Security (birthday Wednesday schedule)
programs.summary: For most people who began benefits in May 1997 or later: paid on the 2nd, 3rd, or 4th Wednesday based on birthday day-of-month band.

rule.notes: Enter only the day-of-month band of your birthday (1–10 / 11–20 / 21–31). We never ask for your full date of birth.

programs.name: Social Security (3rd-of-month schedule)
programs.summary: Common for people who began benefits before May 1997, or who receive both SSI and Social Security for the Social Security portion on the 3rd.

rule.notes: If the 3rd falls on a weekend or federal holiday, payment moves to the preceding business day.

programs.name: VA disability compensation (typical)
programs.summary: VA compensation is typically deposited on the first business day of the month for the prior month’s entitlement. Confirm with VA for your specific award.

rule.notes: This is a general rule of thumb from publicly described VA practice; always verify with VA.gov or your award letter.
